verdict.rationale: a-Shell is an iOS Unix-like terminal, and a terminal could plausibly ship a conversational AI agent, so this axis applies. The evidence documents only shell commands, Vim, programming languages, pkg installs and Apple Shortcuts automation. It contains nothing about an AI agent, conversational control, or git operations such as commit, pull and push.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can direct an AI agent to browse, search, edit, commit, pull, and push in a repository via conversation
